blocks.prompt: 2 (i) Write the equation of the parabola with given elements. Focus \((-3, 2)\); directrix \(x = 5\)
blocks.explanation:
Is sawal mein focus aur directrix dono diye hue hain, vertex nahi. Jab yeh dono maloom hon to seedha definition se kaam lete hain.
Parabola par koi bhi point \(P(x, y)\) lenge.
Us ka focus se faasla aur directrix se faasla barabar rakhenge.
Phir square kar ke simplify karenge; equation khud ban jayegi.
Yeh tareeqa hamesha kaam karta hai, chahe directrix tirchi hi kyun na ho; is liye ise 'master key' samjhiye.
steps:
Diya gaya: focus \(F(-3, 2)\), directrix \(x = 5\), yaani \(x - 5 = 0\).
Maloom karna: parabola ki equation.
Tareeqa: point \(P(x, y)\) ke liye \(|PF| = |PM|\).

Dono faasle
\[|PF| = \sqrt{(x + 3)^{2} + (y - 2)^{2}}\]
\[|PM| = \dfrac{|x - 5|}{\sqrt{1^{2} + 0^{2}}} = |x - 5|\]
Kyun: \(PF\) ke liye do points ka distance formula, aur \(PM\) ke liye point se line tak faasle ka formula.
Dhyan dein: \(x - (-3) = x + 3\); minus minus plus.

Barabar rakh kar square
\[(x + 3)^{2} + (y - 2)^{2} = (x - 5)^{2}\]
\[x^{2} + 6x + 9 + (y - 2)^{2} = x^{2} - 10x + 25\]
\[(y - 2)^{2} = -16x + 16\]
\[(y - 2)^{2} = -16(x - 1)\]
Kyun: dono taraf \(x^{2}\) cancel ho gaya; \(x\) wale terms daayen jama kiye: \(-10x - 6x = -16x\) aur \(25 - 9 = 16\). Aakhir mein \(-16\) common nikala.

Tasdeeq:
Vertex focus \(F(-3, 2)\) aur directrix ke bilkul darmiyan, axis \(y = 2\) par hona chahiye: \(x = \frac{-3 + 5}{2} = 1\), yaani vertex \((1, 2)\). \(a = 4\), \(4a = 16\), aur parabola baayen (focus ki taraf) khulta hai. Bilkul \((y - 2)^{2} = -16(x - 1)\) yahi kehta hai, aur answer key bhi. Khol kar: \(y^{2} - 4y + 16x - 12 = 0\).
Note karein ke jawab ki dono shaklein (bracket wali aur khuli hui) sahi hain; bracket wali se vertex aur direction foran nazar aa jate hain.

blocks.prompt: 2 (ii) Write the equation of the parabola with given elements. Focus \((3, 5)\), vertex \((3, 2)\)
blocks.explanation:
Focus \((3, 5)\) aur vertex \((3, 2)\) dono ka \(x\) ek hi hai, matlab dono ek vertical line \(x = 3\) par hain. Yahi axis hai.
Focus vertex ke upar hai, aur parabola hamesha focus ki taraf khulta hai, to yeh upar khulega.
\(a\) vertex se focus tak ka faasla hai.
Is liye shifted form \((x - h)^{2} = 4a(y - k)\) lagayenge.
Jaise kisi ghar ka darwaza dekh kar pata chal jata hai ke woh kis taraf khulta hai, waise hi focus ki jagah dekh kar parabola ki direction pata chalti hai.
steps:
Diya gaya: focus \((3, 5)\), vertex \((h, k) = (3, 2)\).
Maloom karna: parabola ki equation.
Tareeqa: shifted standard form \((x - h)^{2} = 4a(y - k)\).

\(a\) aur direction
\[a = 5 - 2 = 3\]
Focus vertex ke upar hai, is liye curve upar khulta hai.
Kyun: \(a\) vertex se focus ka faasla hai; dono ka \(x\) same hai to sirf \(y\) ka farq lena kaafi hai.

Equation likhein
\[(x - 3)^{2} = 4(3)(y - 2)\]
\[(x - 3)^{2} = 12(y - 2)\]
Kyun: \(h = 3\), \(k = 2\), \(a = 3\) rakha.
Dhyan dein: \(h\) aur \(k\) ke signs: \((x - 3)\) aur \((y - 2)\), plus nahi.
Agar is mein shak ho to definition se bhi kar sakte hain: directrix \(y = -1\) hai, aur \((x - 3)^{2} + (y - 5)^{2} = (y + 1)^{2}\) khol kar bhi yahi equation aati hai.

Tasdeeq:
Directrix \(y = k - a = -1\). Point \((9, 5)\) (latus rectum ka end, kyun ke \(36 = 12 \times 3\)): \(F(3, 5)\) se faasla 6 aur \(y = -1\) se bhi 6. Khol kar: \(x^{2} - 6x - 12y + 33 = 0\). Answer key bhi yahi deti hai.

blocks.prompt: 2 (iii) Write the equation of the parabola with given elements. Directrix \(x = 4\) vertex \((6, 3)\)
blocks.explanation:
Directrix \(x = 4\) vertical line hai, is liye axis us par perpendicular, yaani horizontal hoga aur vertex se guzrega: \(y = 3\).
Vertex \((6, 3)\) directrix ke daayen hai, aur parabola directrix se door khulta hai, to yeh daayen khulega.
\(a\) vertex se directrix ka faasla hai.
Form: \((y - k)^{2} = 4a(x - h)\).
Pehle figure ka khaka zehan mein banayein: baayen taraf khari directrix, us se 2 units daayen vertex, aur mazeed 2 units daayen focus.
steps:
Diya gaya: directrix \(x = 4\), vertex \((h, k) = (6, 3)\).
Maloom karna: equation.
Tareeqa: shifted form \((y - k)^{2} = 4a(x - h)\).

\(a\) aur direction
\[a = 6 - 4 = 2\]
Curve directrix se door, yaani daayen khulta hai; focus \((6 + 2, 3) = (8, 3)\).
Kyun: vertex directrix se bhi \(a\) door hai aur focus se bhi \(a\) door, magar mukhalif taraf.

Equation likhein
\[(y - 3)^{2} = 4(2)(x - 6)\]
\[(y - 3)^{2} = 8(x - 6)\]
Kyun: \(h = 6\), \(k = 3\), \(a = 2\) rakha.
Dhyan dein: yahan \(y\) square hai kyun ke axis horizontal hai.
Agar shak ho to definition se tasdeeq karein: focus \((8, 3)\) aur directrix \(x = 4\) ke saath \((x - 8)^{2} + (y - 3)^{2} = (x - 4)^{2}\) khol kar bhi yahi equation milti hai.

Tasdeeq:
Point \((8, 7)\): \((7 - 3)^{2} = 16 = 8(8 - 6)\), curve par hai. \(F(8, 3)\) se faasla 4, \(x = 4\) se bhi 4. Khol kar: \(y^{2} - 6y - 8x + 57 = 0\). Answer key bhi yahi deti hai.

blocks.prompt: 2 (iv) Write the equation of the parabola with given elements. Axis \(y = 0\) through \((2, 2)\) and \((6, -3)\)
blocks.explanation:
Axis \(y = 0\) hai, yaani \(x\)-axis. Is ka matlab parabola \(x\)-axis ke gird symmetric hai, vertex \(x\)-axis par kahin \((h, 0)\) hai, aur sirf \(y\) square hoga.
To equation ki shakal \(y^{2} = k(x - h)\) hogi, jahan \(k\) aur \(h\) maloom nahi.
Do unknowns ke liye do equations chahiye, aur do points diye hue hain.
Dono points rakh kar \(k\) aur \(h\) nikal lenge.
Note: yahan focus ya directrix diye hi nahi gaye, sirf axis aur do points. Is liye definition ki jagah shakal (form) se kaam lete hain.
steps:
Diya gaya: axis \(y = 0\); points \((2, 2)\) aur \((6, -3)\) parabola par.
Maloom karna: equation.
Tareeqa: \(y^{2} = k(x - h)\) lein (yahan \(k = \pm 4a\)) aur dono points rakhein.

Points rakhein
\((2, 2)\): \(4 = k(2 - h)\) ...(1)
\((6, -3)\): \(9 = k(6 - h)\) ...(2)
Kyun: koi point curve par tab hi hota hai jab us ke coordinates equation ko satisfy karein.

\(h\) nikalein
(2) ko (1) se divide karein:
\[\dfrac{9}{4} = \dfrac{6 - h}{2 - h}\]
\[18 - 9h = 24 - 4h\]
\[h = -\dfrac{6}{5}\]
Kyun: divide karne se \(k\) khatam ho jata hai aur sirf \(h\) ki ek equation bachti hai. Phir cross-multiply kiya: \(9(2 - h) = 4(6 - h)\).

\(k\) nikalein
(1) se:
\[4 = k\left(2 + \dfrac{6}{5}\right) = \dfrac{16k}{5}\]
\[k = \dfrac{5}{4}\]
Kyun: \(h\) ki value aasaan wali equation mein wapas rakhi.

Equation likhein
\[y^{2} = \dfrac{5}{4}\left(x + \dfrac{6}{5}\right)\]
\[4y^{2} = 5x + 6\]
Kyun: dono taraf 4 se multiply kiya taake fractions khatam hon: \(5\left(x + \frac{6}{5}\right) = 5x + 6\).

Tasdeeq:
\((2, 2)\): \(16 = 10 + 6\). \((6, -3)\): \(36 = 30 + 6\). Dono satisfy karte hain. Vertex \(\left(-\frac{6}{5}, 0\right)\), \(4a = \frac{5}{4}\), daayen khulta hai. Answer key bhi \(4y^{2} = 5x + 6\) deti hai.
Mazeed: \(4a = \frac{5}{4}\) se \(a = \frac{5}{16}\), focus \(\left(-\frac{6}{5} + \frac{5}{16}, 0\right) = \left(-\frac{71}{80}, 0\right)\). Yeh sawal mein nahi poocha, magar is se pata chalta hai ke parabola kafi patla (tang) hai.
